BombVault 10.5.5 lets several servers back up into one shared repository, so files that sit on more than one server are stored only once.

## ✨ Added

- **Shared repository.** An instance with a receiving server can hold one shared repository for its group. The other servers ask to join under **From your group** when they add a storage location, and you let them in on the **Instances** page. Each one copies only its own backups there, through an append-only login of its own, and only the server that holds the repository forgets and prunes. A server you let in has a day to finish joining. After that its one-time key and login are taken back, and it can ask again. Thanks to @Revan335 for the idea. ([#419](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/419))
- **Upkeep in one place.** The window of the receiving server shows how much space the shared repository saves, when it tidies up and how long it keeps each server's backups. Before a prune it tells the other servers, and they hold their copies back until it is done. The server that holds the repository can copy its own backups in as well.
- **What the members see.** The **Instances** page lists the shared repositories this server copies into, with who prunes them, who else is in, how much space they hold and save, and when the owner tidies up next.
- **Restore from other servers.** Under **Other servers** on the Restore page you can get back what the other servers of a shared repository saved there, each one shown with its name and host.
- **Former members.** The owner can forget the backups a server left behind after it went, once you type that server's name. The next tidy-up window frees the space.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Recovery kit and emergency wizard.** The kit has a section on shared repositories. If the server that holds one is lost, its kit makes a new server the owner. The other servers follow it only after it proves it holds the same repository, and they follow it to a new address too.
- **Deferred copies.** A copy that waits while the owner tidies up shows as deferred in the activity log and on the card of that repository, and the off-site copy counts as old as it really is.
- **Comparison with Duplicacy.** The comparison in the README has a column for Duplicacy and rows for deduplication across several servers and for taking over jobs from other tools. Thanks to @Revan335 for asking. ([#418](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/418))

## 🐛 Fixed

- **What's new for 10.5.4.** The entries for system junk excludes and connections per storage location end with a full stop again.

## 🌐 Translations

- **New texts in all 42 languages**, and the guide to off-site recovery has a section on the shared repository in all 26.
